items.t: Cooling fan roars or engine runs hot from a failed fan clutch
items.job: Replace electronic fan clutch
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $787 to $1,055 on 2003-2007 trucks.

items.t: Gas smell or fuel dripping from the tank area
items.job: Replace fuel pump module and lines (tank removal)
items.note: One owner reported about $800.

items.t: Fuel gauge reads wrong or drops to empty
items.job: Replace fuel level sending unit (fuel pump module)
items.note: RepairPal estimates $1,204 to $1,702 by year; one owner was quoted $600 to $1,000.

items.t: Hard cold starts or rough running from clogged injectors
items.job: Clean or replace fuel injectors
items.note: Priced from the Oldsmobile Bravada, which shares this 4.2L engine ($705 to $942). A cleaning service costs less.

items.t: Long cranking from a cracked fuel sending unit port
items.job: Replace fuel pump module (tank removal)

items.t: Engine misfires in wet weather
items.job: Replace spark plugs and damaged plug boots; install deflector

items.t: Instrument panel gauges quit or act up
items.job: Diagnose instrument cluster and body electrical faults
items.note: This is the diagnosis fee. A rebuilt cluster typically adds a few hundred dollars.

items.t: Ignition switch drains the battery or truck won't crank
items.job: Replace ignition switch or lock cylinder
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $188 to $274 for the lock cylinder.

items.t: ABS light on
items.job: Diagnose ABS codes and repair chafed wiring or sensor
items.note: A replacement brake control module costs more.

items.t: Power window pops when going up
items.job: Apply anti-noise tape to window regulator; replace regulator motor if it fails
items.note: The tape fix is cheap. RepairPal estimates about $170 to $357 if the regulator motor itself fails.

items.t: Liftgate glass hard to close or won't lock
items.job: Install softer weather strip and shim kit

items.t: Front clunk from worn stabilizer links
items.job: Replace front stabilizer links

items.t: Squeal or whistle from the front differential
items.job: Inspect front differential for leaks and service the fluid
items.note: Inspection runs about $61 to $90. Worn bearings cost far more to fix.

items.t: Cracked exhaust manifold
items.job: Replace exhaust manifold and gasket
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $637 to $779 on the 2008.

items.t: StabiliTrak light stays on with code C0131
items.job: Diagnose stability control code and replace brake pressure sensor
items.note: Diagnosis is about $61 to $90; parts depend on what is found.

items.t: Driver door switch can short and catch fire (recall)
items.job: Inspect, coat or replace driver door switch module
items.note: Free if it was never done. Isuzu no longer sells vehicles in the US; GM dealers usually handle recalls on this GM-built SUV, so call ahead with your VIN.
